name: trtmc-agent-skills
description: Repo-local Codex skills for TensorRT-Model-Connect developer workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Repo skills for models, docs, profiling, and GitHub
interface.longDescription: Installs concise TensorRT-Model-Connect skills for family development, precision, debugging, profiling, documentation, environment setup, and GitHub workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use $write-git-messages to draft a PR message from my diff.
Use $submit-github-pr to push this branch and open a PR.
Use $transform-model to add this checkpoint as one self-contained family.
Use $debug-trt-mismatch to locate this family's first output divergence.
Use $profile-model to measure this model through its public Task API.
Use $setup-trtmc-environment to prepare this checkout for one family.
